source: Named aft_search cases for failure modes the real-query gate has no row for. Each row names its case class, its expected answer (or that it has none), and how that was verified. Report-only: run_recall_audit.py replays them and records where each answer was lost; no runner fails on their outcome.

repos.aft-evidence: The pinned AFT evidence tree the real-query gate uses (commit 30d4a64f99b3b15fd88be6cf962fff4b3fe5ea17), provisioned by provision_evidence.py and verified against its tree digest.
repos.prefrontal: prefrontal at the commit pinned in corpus/prefrontal.toml, provisioned by provision_corpus.py --corpus corpus/prefrontal.toml.

case_classes.punctuated_prose: A natural-language question that contains a comma or a parenthesis. The router currently treats either character as code syntax and removes the semantic lane.
case_classes.mixed_prose_exact_fragment: Prose that carries one exact identifier or literal fragment next to the words that say what is wanted.
case_classes.op_string_dispatch: The handler of an operation string. The code that answers it is a match arm keyed on the string, not a function named after it.
case_classes.partial_anchor_outranks_answer: One query fragment matches verbatim in many files that do not answer the query, and the answer is found by the rest of the query.
case_classes.validated_no_answer: Nothing in the pinned tree answers the query. Verified by searching the tree for each content word and phrase and reading every hit.

relevance_scale: 2 = the code that answers the query; 1 = supporting code a reader would also accept. Line ranges are 1-based and inclusive, read at the pinned commit.

tasks.query: when a file is larger than the size limit, does the search index skip it (and where is that check)?
tasks.verification: Read crates/aft/src/search_index.rs at the pin: prepare_search_path returns Unindexed when metadata.size > max_file_size (cold build), update_file_with_canonicalization_memo tracks the file as unindexed on the same comparison (incremental update), and DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_SIZE is the 1 MiB default.

tasks.query: how are exact tier results ranked, and why
tasks.verification: This is the unquoted half of the router asymmetry the code-literal misroute investigation recorded (the quoted form routes natural_language, this one code_literal). Read crates/aft/src/commands/semantic_search/comparator.rs at the pin: compare_fields_1_to_6 documents and implements the exact-tier order, and r3_cmp documents why exact candidates are score-free and always precede non-exact ones.

tasks.query: exact_phrase: how the verbatim phrase is normalized before the exact pass compares it
tasks.verification: Read crates/aft/src/commands/semantic_search/exact_lane.rs at the pin: exact_phrase strips one balanced pair of quotes and normalize_exact_phrase collapses whitespace and lowercases; both sit at lines 50-71.

tasks.query: BOARD_LANE_CAP: what happens when a board.lanes update asks for more lanes than the cap
tasks.verification: Read crates/prefrontal-core-store/src/rooms.rs at the pin: the board.lanes update refuses a new lane with a Validation error once live_lanes reaches BOARD_LANE_CAP (3295-3299); the constant and its rationale are at 71-74.

ground_truth.symbol: lane cap refusal in board.lanes update

tasks.verification: Read crates/aft/src/main.rs at the pin: the "semantic_search" arm of the command match (973-979) waits for the semantic index and then calls handle_semantic_search, defined at crates/aft/src/commands/semantic_search/mod.rs 316-462.

Read at the pin: the "mark_auto_proceeded" arm in crates/prefrontal-core-module/src/dispatch.rs (12602-12610) handles the op after the ask. prefix is split off; the op is registered at 11469; the store write it calls is AskStore::mark_auto_proceeded in crates/prefrontal-core-store/src/ask.rs 1750-1760. No function is named after the dotted op string.

tasks.query: where is include_tests applied before top-k selection in the semantic lane
tasks.verification: include_tests occurs verbatim in hundreds of files in the pinned tree, almost none of which answer this. Read crates/aft/src/semantic_index.rs at the pin: search_filtered (3496-3591) applies the include predicate to every entry before the top-k selection, and its doc comment says why; path_allowed_by_include_tests in crates/aft/src/commands/semantic_search/mod.rs (1269-1271) is the predicate passed to it.

Whole-word, case-insensitive search of the pinned tree: stripe, payment and invoice occur only in crates/aft-tokenizer/src/claude_data.rs (tokenizer vocabulary data) and benchmark fixtures or reports; webhook occurs in release workflows (Discord notification) and docs; x-hub-signature does not occur. 'signature verification' occurs only in crates/aft/src/gh_shim.rs (detached signature of a downloaded manifest) and a draft; reading those hits confirms none verifies a payment webhook. The gh_shim hits are a deliberate near-miss.

tasks.query: OAuth2 refresh token rotation for user login sessions
tasks.verification: Case-insensitive search of the pinned tree: oauth2, 'refresh token', 'token rotation' and 'login session' do not occur; refresh_token occurs only in a pytest output fixture under benchmarks/compression-tokens. AFT has no user login.

tasks.query: shopping cart checkout with a discount coupon code
tasks.verification: Whole-word, case-insensitive search of prefrontal at the pin: shopping, cart and coupon do not occur. checkout occurs only for git checkouts and connection checkouts (routing store, cortexkit-cow, persona text, a test); discount occurs only in review prose and an API-price comment (consult/runtime.rs 8622). Reading each hit confirms none is commerce code.

tasks.query: dark mode theme toggle in the settings page
tasks.verification: Whole-word, case-insensitive search of prefrontal at the pin: 'dark theme', 'theme toggle' and 'color scheme' do not occur; 'dark mode' occurs once, in packages/opencode/src/plugin/text-complete.ts line 2, as part of 'go-dark mode' (an agent snooze), not a UI theme. prefrontal has no settings page.
